form:FormGroup.label: Light Background Colour
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: CSS colour name or hex value, e.g. #FF0000.

form:HelpHTML.p: Sets the background colour of matching rows when using the light theme.
The colour is a valid CSS colour name (e.g. red) or a colour in RGB Hexadecimal form (e.g. #FF0000).

form:FormGroup.label: Light Example
